existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Reasonable fee for records (standard request / general)
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public officer may require the requester to pay a reasonable fee set by the public officer before the requester may receive any public records (standard request); more generally, a certified copy is furnished on payment of a reasonable fee.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Officer elects to charge for a standard request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public officer may require the requester to pay a reasonable fee set by the public officer before the requester may receive any public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: 'Reasonable fee ... set by the public officer' — soft-standard; the city/officer supplies the actual value (no statewide rate or per-page ceiling). Fees may increase for extensive requests per the prescribed form notice (36-12-45(b)(3)).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If the public officer elects to charge a fee for a standard request, the officer shall notify the requester of the estimated fee and withhold any public records until receipt of payment.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Officer elects to charge a fee for a standard request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If the public officer elects to charge a fee, the public officer shall notify the requester of the estimated fee and withhold any public records until receipt of payment.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: Ala. Code § 36-12-44(a)(2) (added by SB270, 2024 Reg. Sess.)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Conditional-on-charging notice duty for the standard track.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a standard request where a fee is charged, the public officer shall withhold any public records until receipt of payment.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: A fee has been charged and remains unpaid (standard request)
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If the public officer elects to charge a fee, the public officer shall notify the requester of the estimated fee and withhold any public records until receipt of payment.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: Ala. Code § 36-12-44(a)(2) (added by SB270, 2024 Reg. Sess.)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Payment of estimated fees is the start event for the production constructive-denial clock (AL-0028).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The requester may opt not to pay the fee and thus not receive any substantive response (standard request).
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester declines to pay the estimated fee
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The requester may opt not to pay the fee and thus not receive any substantive response.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: Ala. Code § 36-12-44(a)(2) (added by SB270, 2024 Reg. Sess.)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Terminal state a request can enter (requester abandons by non-payment).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a standard request, the public officer has discretion to require the requester to pay all or a portion of the estimated fee prior to searching for any responsive public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Standard request where officer requires a deposit before searching
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Additionally, the public officer shall have the discretion to require the requester to pay all or a portion of the estimated fee prior to searching for any responsive public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: Ala. Code § 36-12-44(a)(2) (added by SB270, 2024 Reg. Sess.)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Deposit/advance-payment gate before the search step.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Mandatory reasonable fee before response (time-intensive request)
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a time-intensive request, the public officer shall require the requester to pay a reasonable fee set by the public officer before providing a substantive response.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public officer shall require the requester to pay a reasonable fee set by the public officer before providing a substantive response to the requester.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: Ala. Code § 36-12-44(b)(2) (added by SB270, 2024 Reg. Sess.)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: For time-intensive requests charging a fee is mandatory ('shall require'), unlike the permissive standard track (AL-0039). The fee amount remains the reasonable-fee soft standard.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Advance likely-fee notice and withholding (time-intensive request)
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a time-intensive request, the public officer shall notify the requester in advance of any likely fees and shall withhold any substantive response until receipt of payment.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public officer shall notify the requester in advance of any likely fees and shall withhold any substantive response until receipt of payment.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: Ala. Code § 36-12-44(b)(2) (added by SB270, 2024 Reg. Sess.)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Advance likely-fee notice also occurs at the time-intensive designation notice (AL-0031).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a time-intensive request, the public officer has discretion to require the requester to pay all or a portion of the estimated fee prior to searching for any responsive public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Time-intensive request where officer requires a deposit before searching
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Additionally, the public officer shall have the discretion to require the requester to pay all or a portion of the estimated fee prior to searching for any responsive public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_authority: Ala. Code § 36-12-44(b)(2) (added by SB270, 2024 Reg. Sess.)
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Same concept as AL-0043 in the time-intensive track.
